entry.title: Rumor: Huawei Mate X8 foldable launches in November
entry.summary: Huawei will launch the Mate X8 in China in November with Kirin 9050/9050 Pro chips, an 8.15-inch inner and 6.5-inch cover screen, a 50MP 1/1.28-inch variable-aperture main camera, a 50MP periscope and a battery above 6,000mAh, plus a privacy-display version.

entry.title: Confirmed: Honor 700 series launches in November with three models and a rear screen on every model
entry.summary: Honor will launch three Honor 700 models in China in November; every model has a built-in rear display, and the 700 Pro adds a stronger camera setup around a roughly 9,000mAh battery class.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung is testing a $4.99-a-month Galaxy AI Premium subscription
entry.summary: Samsung will offer a paid Galaxy AI Premium plan at $4.99 a month or $47.99 a year, with higher usage limits and paid-only features such as Gen Video, Bixby Action and Daily Briefing, while core features stay free with usage caps.

entry.title: Rumor: SpaceX and Tesla could announce a merger as soon as December
entry.summary: SpaceX and Tesla are progressing toward a merger that could be announced as soon as December 2026, though it may slip into early 2027.

entry.title: Likely: The vanilla Xiaomi 18 launches in December with 100W charging
entry.summary: A standard Xiaomi 18 is still coming this year, around December in China, with 100W wired charging, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, a 200MP main camera and a 7,200mAh battery.

entry.title: Shaky: NVIDIA swaps the RTX 5080 to 24GB in Q1 2027
entry.summary: NVIDIA will release an RTX 5080 with 24GB of GDDR7 in early 2027, gradually replacing the 16GB model.

entry.title: Confirmed: Samsung's Android XR glasses go on sale in mid-December, in Korea and the US only
entry.summary: Samsung's display-free Intelligent Eyewear (Android XR, Gemini, Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1) goes on sale in mid-December in South Korea and the US first, with Europe, China and Japan later; pricing is not set.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo X500 series costs INR 119,999-229,999 in India, launching late November
entry.summary: The vivo X500 (12/256GB) will cost INR 119,999, the X500 Pro INR 149,999 and the X500 Pro Max INR 159,999 (INR 179,999 for 512GB; INR 229,999 for a 'master set'), with a launch toward the end of November.

entry.title: Rumor: AMD's next Halo APU, 'Siren Halo', adds dedicated GDDR7 memory
entry.summary: AMD's next big Ryzen AI Max APU is called Siren Halo, replacing the design previously known as Medusa Halo, and supports dedicated GDDR7 VRAM alongside LPDDR memory, possibly sharing RDNA 5 'AT2' graphics with the next Xbox's Magnus chip.

entry.title: Shaky: Apple is working on a bigger wide foldable, an 'iPhone Duo 2 Plus', to rival a Galaxy Z Fold 9 Plus
entry.summary: Apple is developing a larger wide-format foldable, dubbed 'iPhone Duo 2 Plus', for 2027 to compete with a rumored bigger Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9 Plus.

entry.title: Confirmed: Android 17 QPR2 reaches Pixels in November instead of December
entry.summary: Google skipped the usual first-Tuesday November Pixel patch because it is shipping Android 17 QPR2 early, in November.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple unveils smart glasses at WWDC 2027
entry.summary: Apple will show privacy-focused smart glasses at WWDC 2027 and ship them in late 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 Ultra gets thinner bezels and a thicker camera bump
entry.summary: The Galaxy S27 Ultra will have 1.28mm screen bezels (vs 1.32mm on the S26 Ultra) and a 4.69mm camera bump, slightly thicker than today's.

entry.title: Confirmed: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, the successor to Argon, within weeks
entry.summary: Google's next Gemini 4 checkpoint, Carbon, is in partner early access and will be released publicly soon.

entry.title: Rumor: iPhone Air 2 gets a 6.55-inch 120Hz screen, A20 chip and two 48MP rear cameras
entry.summary: The iPhone Air 2 launches next spring with a 6.55-inch flat 120Hz OLED, a 2nm A20-series chip, 48MP wide and 48MP ultrawide rear cameras and a bigger battery than the first Air.

entry.title: Likely: Huawei's new sub-brand is called Osta and debuts with the flagship-level Osta O1 and wide-screen O1 Pro
entry.summary: Huawei's upcoming sub-brand, reported in Chinese as Xingmang, will be called Osta in English and launch with two flagship-level phones: the Osta O1 with a quad-curved screen and the Osta O1 Pro with a 6.39-inch 1.5K wide-aspect flat screen and up to 16GB/1TB.

entry.title: Likely: One UI 9.5 lets Galaxy phones record WhatsApp, Telegram and Google Meet calls
entry.summary: Samsung's Phone app in One UI 9.5 adds a 'Record calls in other apps' setting with per-app toggles for VoIP calls in WhatsApp, Telegram and Google Meet, possibly limited by country.

entry.title: Rumor: Oppo A7 Ultra launches in December with a 12,000mAh battery
entry.summary: Oppo will launch an A7 Ultra in December with a 12,000mAh battery and a large horizontal rear camera module.

entry.title: Shaky: Honor is testing a 6.39-inch wide-screen phone with a 200MP camera and 8,000mAh battery
entry.summary: A wide-screen phone with a 6.39-inch display, a Snapdragon chip, a 200MP main camera, a periscope telephoto and at least 8,000mAh of battery is in development, apparently from Honor.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung is developing a phone whose screen slides up from 16:9 to 21:9
entry.summary: Samsung is working on a phone with a vertically rolling display that extends from a 16:9 to a 21:9 aspect ratio, with battery capacity as the main challenge because of the sliding mechanism.

entry.title: Shaky: vivo X500 Ultra uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a huge battery and a bigger 200MP telephoto
entry.summary: The vivo X500 Ultra launches in China around March-April 2027 with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a flat 6.85-inch BOE LTPO screen, an ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, a 7,000-8,000mAh battery, a 50MP Sony LYT910 35mm main camera and a 200MP 1/1.2-inch telephoto.

entry.title: Likely: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max cost EUR 1,449-1,849 in Europe with smaller batteries
entry.summary: The European Xiaomi 18 Pro will cost EUR 1,449 (256GB) or EUR 1,649 (512GB) with a 6,000mAh-rated battery and 90W charging, and the 18 Pro Max EUR 1,849 (512GB) with a 7,050mAh-rated battery and 100W, both smaller than the Chinese versions' 7,000mAh and 8,500mAh.

entry.title: Likely: Apple launches an OLED iPad Air, a vapor-chamber iPad Pro and an A19 base iPad in the first half of 2027
entry.summary: Apple will release three iPads in the first half of 2027: an iPad Air with an OLED screen, an iPad Pro with a new chip and vapor-chamber cooling, and a base iPad with the A19, 8GB of RAM (enabling Apple Intelligence), the N1 wireless chip and the C1X modem.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 cameras: Ultra drops to a single 5x telephoto, S27 Pro gets a 10MP 3x zoom
entry.summary: The Galaxy S27 and S27+ keep a 50MP main, 12MP ultrawide and 10MP 3x camera; the S27 Pro and Ultra share a 200MP ISOCELL HP6 main, a 50MP ultrawide and a 16MP selfie camera, but the Pro gets only a 10MP 3x telephoto and the Ultra a single 50MP 5x telephoto.

entry.title: Rumor: OnePlus 17 gets a wide-screen display
entry.summary: The OnePlus 17 will be one of five wide-screen flagship phones launching in 2027, with a wider (roughly 16:9 or 16:10) display aimed at gaming.

entry.title: Rumor: Xiaomi 18 Pro reaches India in December, but the 18 Pro Max skips India
entry.summary: After the Nov 17 global launch, only the Xiaomi 18 Pro comes to India, in December; the 18 Pro Max will not be sold there. The same tipster lists Xiaomi 18T specs (Dimensity 8600, 1.5K 165-185Hz OLED, IP69, 200MP main camera).

entry.title: Rumor: vivo S70 launches soon with a 64MP periscope that supports a teleconverter
entry.summary: vivo's next S-series phone, the S70, has a 64MP Sony LYT-610 periscope telephoto with support for a 200mm teleconverter, a 6.59-inch 1.5K LTPS OLED screen and the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4.

entry.title: Likely: Apple's HomeView will run third-party AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude
entry.summary: Apple's HomeView hub will allow third-party conversational AI apps such as ChatGPT and Claude.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple makes Siri AI a proactive agent as early as 2027
entry.summary: Apple will turn Siri AI into an agent that tracks goals and carries out multi-step tasks on its own, like OpenAI's Dots or Meta's Muse, possibly as soon as next year.

entry.title: Rumor: One UI 9.5 lets Bixby run recurring tasks in the background
entry.summary: Samsung's One UI 9.5 turns Bixby into a task agent that can run scheduled, recurring jobs in the background (for example a daily exchange-rate report), managed from a new Actions menu with an activity log.
